Outfit: Casual
Display Biwa Hayahide

■ Stage Direction
*Vibe of "is this person teasing me on purpose?"

Wh-Why are you laughing?!
I am speaking in all earnestness here!
One day off, when I visited a shopping mall—

...Surely you can see it?
My hair... well, it tends to expand quite easily.

Granted, her hair was fluffy, but it didn't seem particularly out of the ordinary.
As I wondered why she was so concerned about it—

You won't escape. As my trainer,
I need you to understand my plight above all else.

During the rainy season, it is especially pronounced! To me, hair
is not something to be enjoyed with styling. Indeed, it is practically my foe—

...Isn't that mere hindsight bias?
You are trivializing the arduous journey of bitter struggle I endured.
Eh...

Excuse me, I couldn't help but overhear! You seem
quite troubled by your hair care, miss. In that case, our—

N-No, forgive me.
We are fine, thank you.

I don't grow it out because I want to, either. It was a painful compromise
made so gravity could weigh it down, or so I could tie it up. But naturally—
...Let us change locations.

...Picturing a young Biwa Hayahide slathering on heaps of pomade,
I couldn't help but smile at the adorable image.

Since I had the chance, I came looking for any new products.
Even for existing brands, formulas are sometimes revised through ongoing research.

Yet Trainer... even that is insufficient.
For you see, my hair is—

That... may very well be true. All my struggles with my hair
may have forged my stubborn refusal to give up.

Hmm... The variety of essential oils is ample, but the crucial botanical oil is lacking.
I deduce they prioritized fragrance over cosmetic efficacy.

I still remember the shock when I first tied her hair as a child.
That sleek, silky texture running through my fingers... I cried out, asking how this could be the same hair!

...I was just comparing various hair oils.
My current bottle happens to be running low.

Wh-Why are you here... No, shopping, of course.
Still, what a coincidence...

I've tried commercial products, concocted my own treatments,
and even dabbled in the forbidden taboo that is Tachyon-kun. Yet no improvement whatsoever!
Well... as you can see, my hair woes are endless.

...Trainer. You don't... happen to mistakenly believe
my hair naturally looks like this without any effort, do you?

The agony begins the very moment I wake up.
Have you ever bolted upright in bed, nearly suffocated by your own hair?

Biwa Hayahide's expression softened.
It seemed my words had reached her heart. In that case—

In that case, perhaps the one with baobab seed oil from earlier...
However, considering the absorption rate, its composition is lacking... Mmh...

Good grief, you certainly have a unique way of looking at things.
Quite different from mine... Which is likely why I find myself wanting to talk to you about everything.

I make every possible effort regardless. Daily, I apply styling products
to tame stray hairs, and my pre-bedtime hair care routine is exhaustive.

Excuse me, miss~? You've been deliberating for quite a while,
can I assist you with any recommendations~?!
It seems necessary to systematically break down this matter from the top once more.

Feeling frustrated as a child, I tried slicking and tying it back with Father's pomade...
Naturally, it felt nothing like Brian's silky strands. That was true despair...!

...Hardly. I am merely experimenting because of the tangible damages incurred.
If only my natural hair texture were better, I wouldn't have had to struggle so much.

Yes. While it may lack scientific precision as a descriptor,
my hair texture is anomalous enough to warrant such terminology!

However, if that is your conclusion after hearing what I've said...
I must tell you, that solution is erroneous.

—An extreme hybrid of wavy and kinky hair!
Hyper-unruly strands that even professional stylists throw their hands up at...!

...?! 
Tr-Trainer?!

—Now then, let us sit down comfortably, and you can listen
to the report covering the story of my life. Will you join me?

Even so, to lose control and yell in public like that...
I made quite a pathetic spectacle of myself...

Always striving for improvement, continuing to challenge herself no matter how many times she falters.
I told her that it was an episode perfectly fitting for someone as remarkably hardworking as her.

...I cannot simply overlook what you just said.
No, I appreciate your affirmation, and I do not reject your mindset itself.
...I offered my frank opinion, but...

Even after that, for quite a while,
Biwa Hayahide's grievances regarding her hair quality continued...

I apologize for earlier... really. I just have
so many... yes, so many thoughts when it comes to hair.

—*Sigh*... How many times have I wished
that I had straight hair like Brian's instead?

After that, we moved to a cafe, where Biwa Hayahide passionately detailed her complete "Systematic Theory of Frizzy Hair"...
and I feel like... I was able to fully understand her feelings.

—People easily suggest just cutting it short! But that is
a completely terrible move! Do you know how aggravating it is when it puffs out around your face?!
